name: quizzem
description: Quizz'em — real-time trivia + Hold'em hybrid; host, player, display apps and Socket.IO server.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,host,player,display -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm --workspace apps/server run dev" "npm --workspace apps/host run dev" "npm --workspace apps/player run dev" "npm --workspace apps/display run dev:watch"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace packages/core && npm run build --workspace packages/net && npm run build --workspace packages/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run build --workspace apps/host && npm run build --workspace apps/player && npm run build --workspace apps/display
scripts.one: npm run build && powershell -Command Start-Process http://localhost:7777 && npm start --workspace apps/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/host && npm run lint --workspace apps/player && npm run lint --workspace apps/display
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/net/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -b apps/host/tsconfig.json apps/player/tsconfig.json apps/display/tsconfig.json
